hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: There are only 26 lowercase English letters. Model transformations as a directed graph with 26 vertices.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Edge weight between u and v is the minimum conversion cost from character u to v.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Run Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the 26x26 matrix in O(26^3) to find all-pairs shortest transformation costs. Then sum costs for source[i] to target[i].

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
complexity.notes: Efficient execution matching optimal computational complexity.
